# unifi_hotspot_operator (Data Source)

The `unifi_hotspot_operator` data source retrieves an existing hotspot operator by name or id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing hotspot operator by name.
data "unifi_hotspot_operator" "front_desk" {
  name = "front-desk"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the hotspot operator to look up. Either `name` or `id` must be set.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
- `note` (String) A free-form note for the hotspot operator.
- `x_password` (String, Sensitive) The password for the hotspot operator account.
